data.narrative: In Module 04 (Critical Review), Alekhya made a seamless transition into the Senior Engineer phase, conducting a rigorous Pattern-Based audit of the TaskFlow codebase that uncovered 15 concrete findings across the five systematic AI failure categories. She proactively caught the IDOR vulnerability in the invitation route before the BREAK step, formulated an unambiguous fix specification that enforced explicit owner/admin authorization checks, and implemented comprehensive test coverage with 21 passing automated tests.

dimension_scores.observation: Authored precise fix specifications that defined exact database RBAC queries, HTTP 403 error semantics, and explicit negative constraints preventing unintended function refactoring.
dimension_scores.evidence: Constructed the IDOR fix prompt documented in progress/proof_fix_module_04.json that specified checking team ownership and admin membership.

dimension_scores.observation: Audited generated code across all five failure categories (security, edge cases, error handling, naming, test coverage), uncovering deep architectural and security defects rather than settling for superficial syntax checks.
dimension_scores.evidence: Documented 15 findings (1 critical, 3 high, 7 medium, 4 low) in progress/review-findings.md, catching the IDOR vulnerability and sole owner removal bug.

dimension_scores.observation: Resolved the IDOR security vulnerability and edge case gaps in a single, targeted iteration without code regression or bloated diffs.
dimension_scores.evidence: Implemented src/routes/invitations.js and expanded tests/invitation.test.js, taking suite to 21/21 passing tests in under 200ms.

dimension_scores.observation: Selected Option B (Pattern-Based Review) with targeted line-by-line scrutiny of high-risk security and mutation surfaces, balancing speed with thoroughness.
dimension_scores.evidence: Identified that LLM pattern-completion systematically pairs authentication with endpoints while omitting per-resource authorization.

dimension_scores.observation: Shipped a hardened invitation subsystem with full RBAC protection, strict email validation, duplicate prevention, and zero third-party dependencies.
dimension_scores.evidence: 21 automated unit and integration tests passing in tests/*.test.js validating both positive admin flows and negative security/edge case boundaries.

strengths: Human firewall instinct: detects subtle IDOR authorization vulnerabilities that compile and pass naive happy-path tests.
Systematic pattern triage: applies the five failure categories to rapidly dissect AI-generated code while focusing line-by-line attention on high-risk surfaces.
Actionable PR synthesis: crafts professional, empathetic code review feedback that clearly separates blocking security defects from style improvements.
growth_areas: Ready to tackle Interlude 02: Samsung's AI Code Leak and Module 05: Iteration Patterns (the two-iteration rule).
